thread:
Anika: quick post-deploy check — small uptick in 5xx for routing to dedicated pools after the kv-cache format change. 0.4% error rate, affects a subset of long-tail customers. low volume but reproducible in eu-central logs
Ravi: saw the traces. looks like a header mismatch at the LB -> pool handshake for older agents. failing requests have header `x-kv-version: 2` while new runtime expects `3`
Lena: that explains it. should be safe to keep live but we need to avoid autopilot triggering an automated rollback that would roll the whole rollout back (bad for customers on mixed agents). can we set a scoped pin?
deploy-bot: autopilot rollback window active for release r=2026.05.25-0300. To suppress global auto-rollback use `--safety-mutex locked`. Scoped pin commands available: `traffic-pin --pool <pool> --version <v>` or `traffic-skip --agent-version <v>`
Anika: proposing: 1) lock safety-mutex globally for 30m, 2) pin eu-dedicated pools to v3.8.2 (previous stable) for customers with older agents, 3) push a tiny compatibility patch to router to accept x-kv-version 2 for a transition period. Less disruptive than full revert
Omar: product note: we need release notes and a short customer blurb. support should be alerted with recommended troubleshooting steps (clear local kv cache + retry).
support-bot: queued notification to #support with subject "Potential 5xx for dedicated pools (kv-version mismatch)". Template attached.
Ravi: executing pin: `traffic-pin --pool=eu-dedicated --version=v3.8.2 --scope=old-agents`
Lena: safety-mutex locked by Anika until 1729999811 (30m). autopilot suppressed. manual rollback still allowed.
Anika: I'll deploy the router compatibility patch to canary (5% eu) now: `ops apply --svc=router --img=router-compat-1 --slice=canary`
Ravi: canary logs show handshake success. pin is working — error rate on pinned pool back to baseline. overall error still trending downwards.
Anika: interim plan documented: keep pin in place for 2 hours, complete compatibility rollout to 50% then 100% on router, then unpin and re-enable autopilot. if errors >1% in pinned pool, escalate to full rollback.
Omar: drafted customer blurb: "We observed a small increase in errors for dedicated deployments using older agents after today's release. We've pinned routing for affected pools and deployed a compatibility fix. No customer data was impacted. We will monitor and follow up." link: https://company.docs/release-notes/2026-05-25-dedicated-pool-kv-update
Lena: adding runbook note to the release: 1) safety-mutex locked to avoid global autopilot; 2) scoped traffic-pin executed; 3) router compatibility patch canaried -> 50% -> 100%; 4) postmortem item: improve agent handshake backward compatibility tests
Anika: ok thanks. I'll unpin and unlock mutex after 2h if stable. tagging @oncall to keep an eye. :eyes:
